entries.en: Added search functionality to `/permissions` command with `/` keyboard shortcut for filtering rules by tool name
entries.zh: 使用`/`键盘快捷键向`/permissions`命令添加了搜索功能，用于按工具名称过滤规则

entries.en: Show reason why autoupdater is disabled in `/doctor`
entries.zh: 在 `/doctor` 中显示自动更新被禁用的原因

entries.en: Thinking mode is now enabled by default for Opus 4.5
entries.zh: Opus 4.5 现在默认启用思考模式

entries.en: Thinking mode configuration has moved to /config
entries.zh: 思考模式的设置已移至 `/config`

entries.en: Fixed false "Another process is currently updating Claude" error when running `claude update` while another instance is already on the latest version
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个实例已经是最新版本时运行`claude update`时出现的错误“另一个进程当前正在更新 Claude”错误

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers from `.mcp.json` being stuck in pending state when running in non-interactive mode (`-p` flag or piped input)
entries.zh: 修复了`.mcp.json`中的 MCP 服务器在非交互模式下运行时陷入挂起状态的问题（`-p`标志或管道输入）

entries.en: Fixed scroll position resetting after deleting a permission rule in `/permissions`
entries.zh: 修复了删除`/permissions`中的权限规则后滚动位置重置的问题

entries.en: Fixed word deletion (opt+delete) and word navigation (opt+arrow) not working correctly with non-Latin text such as Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, and Chinese
entries.zh: 修复 opt+delete（删除单词）和 opt+方向键（单词移动）在西里尔文、希腊文、阿拉伯文、希伯来文、泰文、中文等非拉丁文字中工作不正确的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude install --force` not bypassing stale lock files
entries.zh: 修复了`claude install --force`不绕过过时的锁定文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed consecutive @~/ file references in CLAUDE.md being incorrectly parsed due to markdown strikethrough interference
entries.zh: 修复了 CLAUDE.md 中的连续 @~/ 文件引用由于 markdown 删除线干扰而被错误解析的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed plugin MCP servers failing due to colons in log directory paths
entries.zh: Windows：修复了日志目录路径中包含冒号导致插件 MCP 服务器失败的问题
